name: PROFIT_BUNDLE4
rank_basis: each formation month, eligible securities with all four finite components
score: 100 * weighted mean of component rank percentiles
internal_signal: score / 50 - 1; centered on the formation sample
missing_policy: all four required; no imputation or silent reweighting
broad_comparator: PROFIT_BUNDLE3: equal-weight FCF/CFO/gross-profit percentiles, all three required, ranks in its own complete-case universe
same_universe_comparator: bundle3_common4 uses the first three ranks in the four-component universe
fourth_component: local Fama-French 2015 annual OP/book equity, not the public RMW factor return and not an exact current French Library replication
public_four_factor_basket: separate diagnostic: equal monthly allocation to the three existing gross factor returns and public RMW in identical holding windows
regime_timing: no regime gate; report conditional returns using existing causal regimes
